svg.text: 194 x 384 - 6.25in landscape top, 11in portrait below. cutouts 147.18x68.70 and 153.22x241.67, gap 18.0 (glass gap 9.0). Plus 7 back stiffener pieces nested inside the 11in window (grey dashed = where they bond behind the panel), 2 name pieces in the 6.25in window, the 54 mm Hunab Ku keyring above the strips and the 76 mm "ginger" lettering beside it.
